one_month_reasoning: ALAB's own Q3 2026 report is expected around Nov 3, 2026 (estimated, not yet confirmed), i.e. just after the 2026-10-29 window closes, so no company earnings fall in the window. In-window events: late-October hyperscaler earnings (Microsoft/Alphabet/Meta/Amazon capex commentary, typically last week of October), which management frames as the key demand driver (capex 'could exceed $1 trillion next year'); these lean mildly supportive but are two-sided for a high-beta AI name. The stock has been volatile (fell ~36% from the $499 high, rebounded ~13% on Sep 4, -3.7% on Sep 28). With no company catalyst, I stay near symmetric around the current price with a slight positive drift (median ~$359) and monthly sigma ~22% (below the 99%/3.5 = 28% realized figure because the earnings print is outside the window).

fair_value.method: Blend of forward P/E (NTM EPS as of Sep-2027 ~$8.30 x 45x = $374, 60%) and EV/NTM sales (~$3.9B x 16x + ~$2.5B net cash over ~192M diluted shares = $336, 40%), giving ~$360.

inputs_detail.derivation: Q4'26 consensus EPS $1.42 already annualizes to $5.68; FY27 consensus $6.39 looks conservative vs. management commentary that Scorpio X design wins, Scorpio P, custom/NVLink Fusion and Leo CXL all ramp in 2027. I use FY27 ~$6.9 and ~25-30% growth into the following four quarters as gross margin drifts toward the 70% long-term target (guidance/transcripts), giving ~$8.3.

Stock trades ~56x FY27 consensus today ($357.84/$6.39); growth should decelerate from ~100% to ~30-40% by late 2027, so I compress the multiple to 45x, still a premium to large-cap AI semis for faster growth.

bear.story: AI capex digestion in 2027 and/or Scorpio X losing sockets to NVLink/Broadcom alternatives; top-3 customer concentration (69% of Q2 revenue) bites, growth stalls near Q4'26 run-rate, EPS ~$6.5 and multiple de-rates to ~30x.

base.story: Scorpio X broadens to more hyperscalers, P-Series/Leo/custom ramp in 2027 as guided; FY27 EPS ~$6.9, NTM EPS ~$8.3 at ~45-47x; gross margin drifts toward 70%.

bull.story: Content per XPU exceeds $1,000 and UALink/NVLink Fusion custom wins land; revenue >$3.6B in FY27 (top of consensus range), NTM EPS ~$10 at 60x.

thesis_break_reason: Below ~$215 the stock would trade at ~30x FY27 consensus EPS, a level that would only make sense if the market believed the Scorpio X ramp or 2027 hyperscaler programs had slipped or were lost (e.g. a Q4 guide below Q3, or one of the top-3 customers cutting orders). That is a fundamental break, not ordinary volatility, even for a stock with ~99% realized vol.

reasoning: Primary documents show an extraordinary ramp: Q2 2026 revenue $392.4M (+104% y/y), non-GAAP EPS $0.80, and Q3 guidance of $540-560M revenue and $1.16-1.21 EPS, with Scorpio X becoming the largest product family a quarter early (8-K, call transcript). The 10-Q adds what recaps skip: top-3 customers are 69% of revenue, Customer B went from <10% to 25%, inventory nearly doubled to $114M (mostly WIP, consistent with a ramp), $640M of unrecognized RSU expense, and a new 3.26M-share customer warrant at $142.82 that reduces revenue. At the Citi TMT conference (Sep 9) management said Scorpio X engagements rose to the high teens, all US hyperscalers are shipping, and GM will trend toward 70%. Consensus FY27 EPS is $6.39 (revised up from $4.53 60 days ago), which looks conservative vs. a Q4'26 run-rate of $5.68. At $357.84 the stock is ~56x FY27 consensus. My blended fair value of ~$360 (P/E $374, EV/sales $336) says the growth is roughly priced, with upside if 2027 programs land. Scenarios (bear $200 / base $390 / bull $600 at 25/50/25) give a mean of ~$395. For the ladder I use a lognormal with median ~$372 and sigma ~0.68: below the 99% realized vol, since part of that was a momentum run-up and reversal, but well above large-cap norms given the concentration and AI-cycle beta. Research was focused and used about 8 web queries plus consensus data.
